title: The Spear Hero’s Choice
text: “Motoyasu’s life belongs to Motoyasu. If you want to end it here, I’ll accept that as the best choice.”
“Father…”
“Besides, even though he’s a bit eccentric and can be a handful at times, I actually like Motoyasu quite a bit.”
“I’m truly honored by your words, Father.”
“Yeah… Even though things have turned out this way, if I can keep moving forward with Motoyasu, Keel, Sakura, Yuki, Kou, Luna, Melty, Lars-chan, Elena, Wyndia, and Gaelion… I’d be happy.”
Hearing those words, I felt a warmth in my chest.
“That’s why, Motoyasu, I want you to make the choice.”

Hearing those words, I hesitated just a little. A world where Filo-tan might not be there. It’s incredibly sad, but to continue living alongside everyone I’ve been with until today—I think that’s a compelling prospect.

However, my mind was already made up. I made a promise to my father—and to Filo-tan—in the first world. To fight to make this a truly peaceful world. As long as that possibility remains, I simply cannot give up.
“Father, I’ll keep fighting for true peace.”
“I see… Haha… I wonder why. Even though I know it’s the right choice, the thought of saying goodbye here makes me feel sad…”
My father wore a complex expression—one that seemed both happy and sad, almost contradictory.
“This isn’t goodbye.”
“Huh?”
“It’s true that no one else has any memories of me, but this world connects to the next.”
“…You’re right. We’ll just have to meet again in the next world. Yeah, Motoyasu, I’m counting on you for the next world.”
“I’ll take care of it.”

I nodded. That’s right—nothing I’ve gained in this world will go to waste. Level, experience, materials, knowledge—it’s all connected. As I thought that and turned around, I saw Yuki-chan wearing a sad expression.
“Motoyasu-sama… Does that mean we might have to say goodbye to you forever?”
“Well…”
“I couldn’t bear that!”
“Yuki-chan, it’s just a possibility, and we haven’t even tried it yet, so calm down.”
“But…”
“Either way, do you all think this kind of ending is right?”

At Father’s words, Yuki-chan and the others shook their heads. After all, the Filolial-sama absolutely hate sad things. If there’s another path available instead of choosing this kind of ending, I’m sure they’ll accept it.
“Ah… It’s a shame I can’t give Motoyasu-kun the Faubrey portal because of the time remaining.”
After all, portals do have a long cooldown, no matter how you look at it. Considering the time left, my Father probably won’t be able to use it.
“Does everyone have theirs?”
“I forgot!”
Sakura-chan answers in her usual laid-back tone.
“We were Spirit Tortoises, so we don’t have one.”
“I’ve obtained the portal to the Sealed Land of the Phoenix.”
“Then let’s give it to Motoyasu-kun before we make our choice. If… something like this happens again, it’ll give him the power to prevent it before it happens.”
“Um…”
The Queen raises her hand and steps into our circle.
“What is it?”

“I understand the circumstances. I’m sure people all over the world are dissatisfied with this outcome. However… if the Heroes make a decision on their own, I imagine there would be protests from various nations.”
“Well, as for that… please just accept it because we’re short on time.”
“…I understand. Whatever the outcome may be, let’s accept our fate.”
The Queen is quite understanding. Well, given that two-thirds of the world’s population has been lost, it’s not surprising she feels that way.
“If this could all be undone, Luna… I’d like to do all sorts of things with Keel.”
Luna-chan is hugging Keel from behind. What does that mean, I wonder?
“B-Brother! I have a feeling I’m in serious danger here!”
“Luna-chan, please hold off on that just a little while longer.”
“If Spear-Brother goes off somewhere, what’s going to happen to me, Brother!?”
“Keel, don’t worry. It’s just the magic of words.”
“As long as it’s as if it never happened, right?”
“Ah! Right!”
My father really thought this through. If it doesn’t get erased, we can’t do it. Oh? Luna-chan has noticed and is puffing up her cheeks.
“This has turned into a bit of a hassle, hasn’t it? Well, I don’t mind taking a gamble.”
“If we do rewind time and happen to meet again somewhere, please take care of me, Lars-chan.”
“Sure thing. I never got bored spending time with you, after all. If there’s a next time, I’ll count on you.”
Well then, all that’s left is to memorize the portal’s location. I joined the teleportation and memorized the portal to the Land of the Phoenix. Hmm? My Rival’s coming this way.
“It’s Gaelion! If we rewind, I have a favor to ask.”
“I don’t listen to my Rival!”
“Motoyasu-kun, let’s at least hear her out a little. Gaelion has all sorts of skills, after all.”
“Having Gaelion around is handy for making good use of the shards left over after killing the Dragon Emperor of Takt!”
“…Spear Hero.”
Following my Rival, my Assistant spoke up. Does this one have something to say to me, too?
“What is it?”
“If… we could rewind time, I’d like you to make sure my dad… doesn’t get killed by the Sword Hero.”
“Hmm, that’s not a bad suggestion.”
“That would put Gaelion in a bind!”
“Why!?”
The assistant and my Rival started glaring at each other. Is this what they call a sisterly squabble?
“Gaelion! Your dad wouldn’t have to die!”
“If that happens, Gaelion won’t be able to meet Naofumi!”
“Aren’t you sad that Dad died, Gaelion? Don’t you want to stop it if you can?”
“I don’t!”
The assistant is shedding big tears, as if she can’t believe it. Even I can understand how she feels on this one. I wonder what the Rival is thinking.
“U… uwaaaaah… hmm. Gaelion… don’t say things like that…”
Seeing the assistant sobbing uncontrollably, the Rival began to panic.
“Ah—yeah, I’m sorry, big sis. So, I’m going to tell you what your dad was hiding for your own good.”
“Huh…?”
The assistant, who had been soothed by Father, looked at the Rival with a bewildered expression.
“Huh!? S-stop it!”
His voice had completely changed. Even his gaze is different. This is the parent version of Gaelion.
“Huh?”
“Wyndia hasn’t quite grown up enough yet… but it’d be good for her to have you as emotional support… since she’s still worried about hitting Ren.”
“Are you saying that too?!”
“D-Dad?”
“N-no. Gyaaah!”
“Gaelion… your daughter’s speech ending is ‘-no!’”
“Huh!?”
“Daddy!”
The Assistant hugged her Rival.
“Why? Why is Daddy inside Gaelion!?”
“It seems he entered Gaelion-chan when she inherited the Dragon Emperor’s fragment. He’d been hiding it because he thought it would be better for Wyndia-chan to live in the human world.”
“No way—”
Then the assistant puffed out her cheeks and got all sulky. She’s quite the busy little thing—one minute crying, the next getting angry.
“Well, I don’t really have time to talk about this right now, so Motoyasu… don’t worry about it too much.”
“You have to worry about it! I’m asking you, Spear Hero! If we do end up rewinding time, please ask my dad, Gaelion, to lend us his strength.”
“Do you think I can convince him?”
“Dad’s the weakest Dragon Emperor! If a hero asks him, he’ll definitely help. He’ll think he can get stronger!”
“Ah… yeah. You might be right.”
“You lot, enough of making fun of me.”
“Dad, you’re an idiot!”
“Huh! Wyndiaaaaaaa!”
And just like that, the Assistant and my Rival started chasing each other.

“Um, first, let’s have a debriefing. Following history exactly will clear my name of the false accusations, but it’ll come at a cost—like the life of Ms. Eclair, for example. So I want you to learn from this failure.”
“Understood.”
“So, the biggest mistake this time was… failing to convince Ren and Itsuki.”

That’s right. It’s all because of Ren and Itsuki… I’m not sure which one of them, but they unsealed the Phoenix and ended up unsealing the Spirit Tortoise as well. The reason for that is that we failed to persuade Ren and Itsuki, isn’t it? Regardless of the outcome, those two know how to break the seals. So it’ll be extremely difficult to stop them.
“Both Ren and Itsuki are convinced they’ve been transported into the game world they believed in. I think that’s the key.”

“That’s right. But persuading them will be difficult. We’ll have them challenge the Spirit Tortoise like they did in the first world and let them fail. Then you and my Father will clean up the mess with minimal damage.”
“That’s one option, but there’s a better way. I’ve been thinking about ‘what if’ scenarios myself, so I’d like you, Motoyasu, to give it a try.”
“Oh! So you have a brilliant idea?”
“First, Motoyasu, try to remember what you thought when you first came to this other world—that’s probably what Ren and Itsuki are thinking right now.”
My father is great at devising strategies, so I’m sure it’ll work out. I listened intently as he explained the method he had in mind.
“—Try doing it that way. It might mean we can’t stay in Melromarc in the end, but I think Ren and Itsuki will believe us.”
“I see! That’s a brilliant idea.”
“Melty-chan, I’m sorry. I think doing this will minimize the damage to Melromarc. After all… even the Queen said that summoning a hero was a mistake to begin with.”
“Yes… but… please, even though I’m extremely anxious, please make sure Naofumi-sama and I get to meet.”
“I’ll do it if I remember.”
“Why not! Just do it!”
“Now, now.”
My father smiles as he holds back his Finacée. Just then, it came into view, and I realized the remaining time was running out.
“We’re almost at the limit, aren’t we?”
“I see… I thought there’d be more time, but an hour goes by surprisingly fast, doesn’t it?”
“Last time, we rushed back, after all. You can still listen for a little while longer.”
My father and my companions are lined up as if to see me off.
“Like I said earlier, when you’re trying to convince Ren and Itsuki, think about what you originally had in mind.”
“Strike while the iron’s hot! I’ll definitely make your plan a success, Father.”
My father nodded vigorously.

“If that plan succeeds, I don’t think we’ll be able to stay in Melromarc. But I think it’ll lead to a better outcome faster than waiting for the future. Also, Takt might be in Faubrey, but I don’t think you need to be too wary of him. After all, by then, Ren, Itsuki, and I will be right by Motoyasu-kun’s side.”
“But Takt’s remaining followers will cause trouble.”
“We’ll rely on the King of Faubrey for that. And as for Takt’s… well, his entourage is full of beautiful women, so if we handle it skillfully, we can avoid a war. No doubt about it.”
“Is that so?”
“Yeah, the King of Faubrey wants the Four Saints more than the Seven Stars, but he’s the kind of person who knows how to hold back. So even a pretty unreasonable request should go through.”
“I see.”
“Well, it doesn’t have to be Faubrey—any other country would work, too. If we take Melty-chan’s advice, I think we’d be more likely to run into them there.”
I see. Motoyasu, I’ve taken Father’s wish to heart.
“One last thing… Motoyasu, I was so happy to have your help. I can’t thank you enough. I know it might be selfish of me to ask this after everything, but could I ask you for a favor?”
“Just tell me what you need.”
There’s no doubt in Father’s words. Above all, if he’s asking me for a favor, I simply can’t refuse.
“Right now… I think Ren and Itsuki are filled with regret.”
“They’re undoubtedly regretting it.”
I picture Ren and Itsuki, whose whereabouts are currently unknown. Since the loop hasn’t restarted, they must still be alive somewhere. They’re probably pale-faced and in despair.
“Even though we tried to stop them time and time again, they went through with it anyway. I think it’s their own fault.”
“That’s true.”
“But I want you to help them.”
…Help Ren and Itsuki? Considering this loop, I don’t see any need for it at all…
“I’m sure right now, they regret it so much they’d want to kill themselves. If they could go back to that day, I think they’d say they want to act differently so this wouldn’t happen.”
That day, you say? You must be referring to the very first day we arrived in this world. I’m about to loop back to that day myself. Which means, Father…
“Of course, it’s not just for emotional reasons. If we can win Ren and Itsuki over and put our enhancement methods into practice, there won’t be any allies more reliable than them.”
It’s true—if we can make that happen, both Ren and Itsuki will be incredibly strong. In fact, in the first world, they were just as strong as I am.
“So… just as you helped me, I want you to help Ren and Itsuki.”

To ask me to help Ren and Itsuki—the very ones who turned the world into this mess. You really are kind, Father. If the Father from the first world heard that, he’d probably just snort in derision. But I respect both this version of you and the one from before. …In that case, there’s only one thing I can say.
“Understood. I, Motoyasu, will save Ren and Itsuki.”
“Yeah, thanks. Sorry for always asking you to do the impossible…”
Hearing my words, my Father gave me a smile.
“Motoyasu, I can only offer the usual platitudes, but do your best… Even if everything ends up being erased, I’m rooting for you.”
“Yes, sir.”
When my Father waved, everyone waved back.
“Well then, see you later—”

I selected the “No” option. Then, just like when the loop began, my vision froze, a clock appeared, and the spear began to vibrate and spin backward. It seems there are multiple conditions required to trigger a loop using the Minute Hand of the Dragon Hourglass.

Since I’ve defeated the Four Spirits by this point, I probably won’t fail, but considering the process, it’s also true that it would take too long. In that case, let’s try acting according to what my Father said.
If I do too many good deeds, civil unrest will break out, and Itsuki will come to view us as enemies. As a result, it will trigger the Four Spirits’ rampage.
To fulfill Father’s wish, I’ll return once more to that moment in time. As I’ve thought before, I’ll keep my promise to Father based on the information I’ve gained from the loop.
And so, I—returned to the past once again.
The Melromarc arc has come to an end. Starting with the next episode, we’ll move on to the Faubrey arc.
